# Enterprise Tasks

> Enterprise Tasks is a Laravel 13 application for private personal task management with a separate, role-protected administrative workspace.

## Public pages

- `/about`: product story, mission, and values.
- `/capabilities`: overview of supported product capabilities.
- `/capabilities/task-capture`, `/capabilities/progress-tracking`, `/capabilities/secure-apis`, `/capabilities/administrative-governance`: dedicated capability pages.
- `/blog`: product and operational-practice journal.
- `/terms`: terms of service.
- `/sitemap.xml`: indexable public URLs.

## Authenticated application

- `/login`, `/register`: standard account access.
- `/dashboard`: private personal task workspace.
- `/api/tasks`: Sanctum-protected CRUD API scoped to the authenticated task owner.
- `/admin/*`: role-protected staff workspace for moderation, users, audit logs, and settings.

## Important boundaries

- Personal task data is private and owner-scoped.
- Admin authorization is role-based and separate from personal task flows.
- Administrative mutations are auditable.
- `/dashboard`, `/profile`, `/admin/`, and `/api/` are not indexable.

## Stack

Laravel 13, PHP 8.5, Blade, Livewire 4, Tailwind CSS 4, Vite, SQLite by default, Sanctum, and PHPUnit.
